summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by SCS LABS Corporation (formerly Lehman ABS Corporation), as depositor on behalf of the Corporate Backed Trust Certificates, Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities-Backed Series 2004-6 Trust. Item 8.01 reports a standard periodic distribution to certificate holders on August 17, 2026, with details in Exhibit 99.1 (Trustee's distribution statement). No other reportable transactions or matters occurred. The registrant references Goldman Sachs Group as the issuer of the underlying junior subordinated debentures but notes no participation in its reporting. This is a pass-through trust's ordinary distribution notice, not a special situation.
